=='''Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode'''==

My memory is very hazy this morning. I vaguely remember a goth woman with black pigtails. She is wearing a black dress with a short skirt and white stockings.

I remember seeing her standing on a dusty dirt road. She is in the middle of an abandoned old western town. The buildings around her appear to be charred and collapsed ruins.

She has a strange cloudy purple aura. I feel as if she is looking at me, even though I am a disembodied observer. I believe she possesses some kind of power.
